exact: positive regulation of cell migration by VEGF signaling pathway
positive regulation of cell migration by vascular endothelial growth factor signalling pathway

definition: The series of molecular signals initiated by vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) binding to its receptor on the surface of a cell, which activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of the orderly movement of a cell from one site to another.
label: positive regulation of cell migration by vascular endothelial growth factor signaling pathway
